visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are positioned in a modern, well-lit kitchen area with dark wood cabinets and a grey countertop. The woman on the left, dressed in an oversized grey zip-up hoodie and loose-fitting light blue jeans, faces the woman on the right. The second woman wears a dark olive-brown hoodie and baggy denim shorts. They gesture actively with their hands during a rhythmic countdown phase, standing on a dark wooden floor. (2) In a sequence of quick cuts, the woman in the dark brown hoodie is seen smiling and laughing while her hood is pulled up and held by an arm extending from the grey hoodie woman. The camera follows her at a high angle as she is steered across the kitchen floor. Kitchen appliances like a coffee machine and white textured walls are visible in the background background. (3) The scene transitions to the woman in the grey hoodie standing atop a beige wooden step stool. She reaches down to hold the hood of the dark-clothed woman who mimics a running motion below her. A small black dog wanders briefly in the background near a white door and a bookshelf. The indoor lighting is bright and even. (4) The grey-hooded woman is then shown from a back-side angle, being pulled by her own hood towards a hallway. She smiles back toward the camera as she is led. An air purifier with a glowing digital ring sits on the floor next to a vertical wooden wall paneling.
